limitations: Does not classify alphabets of size three or more, arbitrary bounded or unbounded sequences; does not assert novelty of finite-state generating-function techniques; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_integrity: All claimed infinite statements are supported by a symbolic local-window proof and a finite exact transfer-matrix derivation; the finite tests are corroborative, not a substitute. Existing isolated periodic examples are explicitly acknowledged.
title: Two-level rigidity and exact word growth for Van der Laan sequences
